summary: All five overlay regression categories now pass; importer integration and restricted test updates block completion.
body:
Changed only [overlay.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/overlay.rs) and the permitted ignores/regression entries in [sr_core_corpus.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs). Nothing committed or pushed; coordination locks released.

The closure now preserves enclosing containers and their clocks, retains build programs for deferred IDs, follows materialOverride and voxel-palette material references transitively, and retains geodesic camera/hole/disk context. Traversal is iterative, with budgets of 100,000 selected nodes, depth 256, and 2,000,000 work units.

No public API changes. The internal signature remains:
`pub(super) fn document(doc: &SceneDoc<'_>, r: &Resolved, n: &ResolvedNode, opts: &ImportOptions) -> Result<(String, Vec<u8>, bool)>`.

Design grounding: XSD `object3DType/materialOverride` defines name:id pairs; `object3DType/palette` defines material IDs except the `file` keyword; `cameraType/geodesics` and `blackHoleType` require shared rendering context. Generator ownership cannot be determined without execution, so all build emitters are retained, preserving subsequent ambiguity checking. Literal DOM IDs take precedence; numeric beat/bar IDs retain their grid. The XSD’s clock wording leaves the scaling origin implicit: following `sr-eval/src/program.rs::Clock::Affine`, origin=2, offset=2, scale=2 maps child [4,8) to global [5,7).

No renderer source code was borrowed. Semantics were checked against `/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-model/src/program_ids.rs`, `sr-model/src/rules.rs`, and `sr-eval/src/program.rs`.

TDD red→green, all on the VM:

| Regression test | Observed red | Green |
|---|---|---|
| `scene_corpus_external_expression` | Sibling dependency refused | Pass |
| `scene_corpus_generated_id` | Dependency g1 missing | Pass |
| `scene_corpus_material_override` | MOV2 | Pass |
| `scene_corpus_voxel_palette` | VOX6 | Pass |
| `scene_corpus_geodesic_camera` | BH5 | Pass |

Focused tests also went red→green: `overlay_external_dependency_keeps_enclosing_clocks` (sibling refusal), `overlay_generated_reference_keeps_all_build_emitters` (g1 missing), `overlay_generated_marker_keeps_grid_and_explicit_marker_wins` (beat.2 missing), `overlay_string_material_dependencies_are_transitive` (MOV2), and `overlay_geodesic_context_is_kept_from_either_root` (BH5). Budget tests `overlay_dependency_node_budget`, `overlay_dependency_depth_budget`, and `overlay_dependency_work_budget` failed against an unbounded selection stub because excess selection incorrectly succeeded; all pass with bounds restored. All 10 focused tests pass. Initial fixture dimension omissions were corrected and source validation added before repeating the semantic red runs.

Pinned corpus comparison, 1,343 cases:

| Failure category | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| external-expression | 122 | 0 |
| generated-id | 12 | 0 |
| material-override | 6 | 0 |
| voxel-palette | 14 | 0 |
| geodesic-camera | 18 | 0 |
| fractional-depth | 11 | 11 |
| linked-audio | 72 | 72 |

Total failure records: **255→83**; affected cases: **201→29**. Imports, exports, and schema-oracle checks each increased **1,676→2,020**; successful re-imports increased **3,352→4,040**. Every remaining failure record existed in the baseline; none increased.

Validation: formatting and Clippy pass with zero warnings; Wasm passes for 51 crates. The exact gate fails on the obsolete sibling-refusal assertion: 222 unit tests pass, one fails. Filtering that assertion and the identified regression-table assertion yields 326 passing tests, three existing ignores, and two filtered tests. The unfiltered corpus target reports 19 passing tests, two failures, and three ignores: the remaining corpus failures above plus the regression-table assertion. Evidence: [gate log](/tmp/fixoverlay-gate.log), [final validation log](/tmp/fixoverlay-final.log), [baseline log](/tmp/fixoverlay-red-corpus.log).

Your file-scope restriction leaves required integration work outstanding:

- `scene/import.rs` must coalesce promoted overlays, use their enclosing interval, and suppress covered native/separate overlay clips. The current caller can render retained siblings twice; this patch is not ready to merge alone.
- `scene/import/tests.rs::scene_import_overlay_external_expression_dependency_refused` must assert successful preservation instead of refusal.
- Two harness tests in `sr_core_corpus.rs` must use an independent synthetic regression instead of assuming the removed material-override entry remains at `KNOWN_REGRESSIONS[1]`.

Those scope requests remain unanswered, so these changes were not made.
